summary: This is a computational prediction report for Challenge A1, targeting human EGFR extracellular domain (UniProt P00533). The pipeline generated 250 raw designs, of which 4 passed all interface quality gates. All metrics are computational predictions only — no binding affinity (KD) has been measured, and no experimental validation has been performed.

content_blocks.title: Challenge Metadata & Status
content_blocks.content: Challenge: A1. Target: human EGFR ECD (UniProt P00533). PDB admitted: 8HGO / chain A. PDB actually run: 1IVO / chain A (protocol deviation noted). Status: computational prediction only — not a KD, not a measured binder. Cost: $6.05 USD (BIOS staging MCP). OpenLabs project references provided for traceability (discussion, claim, and project UUIDs). This document represents TRL 1 — basic concept/computational stage with no experimental evidence of binding.

content_blocks.title: Pipeline Summary
content_blocks.content: Design pipeline: 250 raw designs generated. Interface filtering retained 4 designs. Rejection breakdown: shape filter rejected 7, chemistry filter rejected 55, confidence filter rejected 184. Gate-passed designs: 4 (3 from rfd3 engine, 1 from boltzgen engine). Selectivity: no number available — panel 0/6 scored, margin null. Novelty legs: unchecked (stage completed but per-leg fields not exposed). Molecular dynamics (MD): skipped. Key caveat: 4/250 is NOT described as a hit rate.

key_findings: Target is human EGFR extracellular domain (UniProt P00533); all work is computational only — no measured binding (KD) exists.
250 raw designs were generated; only 4 passed interface quality gates (shape, chemistry, and confidence filters).
Rejection breakdown: 184 failed confidence filter, 55 failed chemistry filter, 7 failed shape filter.
4 gate-passing designs span 2 engines (rfd3: 3 designs; boltzgen: 1 design) and 4 distinct clusters, suggesting structural diversity.
ipSAE_pred scores for passed designs range from 0.557 to 0.717 — these are predicted interface quality scores, not experimental affinities.
Selectivity panel was not scored (0/6); selectivity margin is null — no selectivity data available.
Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were skipped — no stability validation performed.
A protocol deviation was noted: PDB admitted was 8HGO/chain A but 1IVO/chain A was actually used in the run.
Project cost to date: $6.05 USD (BIOS staging MCP).
TRL assessment: TRL 1 — purely computational concept stage with no experimental validation.
